gym.description: In the Pokémon gym, you can prove your worth by building the best team possible to try to win all 8 badges. Will you be able to achieve it?

moveset.description: There is a hidden Pokémon, and the only clues we have are its moves, its ability, and its generation. Can you guess which one it is?

types_challenge.description: Test your knowledge of the type chart.

build_pokemon.description: With Regieleki's speed, Stakataka's defense, and Rayquaza's attack, you’ll create the strongest Pokémon!

calculator.description: A tool to find the strengths and weaknesses of any Pokémon. Also useful for learning the type chart.

synergies.title: List of Synergies
synergies.text:
Same Type Bonus
Obtained when you have 3 Pokemon of the same type
Same Generation Bonus
Obtained when you have 3 Pokemon from the same generation
Non-Legendary Team Bonus
Obtained when no Pokemon in your team is Legendary or Mythical
1-Shot Bonus
Obtained only when you still have the 3 rerolls available
Desperation Bonus
Obtained if, after using the last reroll, you still need 4 team members
Elemental Trinity
Obtained when you have the following types in your team: Fire - Water - Grass. Has levels 1, 2, and 3
Martial Mindset
Obtained when you have the following types in your team: Fighting - Psychic - Dark. Has levels 1, 2, and 3
Frozen Fortress
Obtained when you have the following types in your team: Ground - Ice - Steel. Has levels 1, 2, and 3
Elemental Perfection
Obtained when you have 10 different types in your team

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.text:
How do I play?
In the options, there is a tutorial

What is the hard mode?
In hard mode, the stars indicating a Pokémon's power are not displayed. It can be toggled on and off in the options.

How does luck work?
Luck is a random factor that can enhance or decrease your final score. It varies from -3% to +5%, so on average, it will benefit you. It can be toggled on and off in the options.

How do synergies work?

With some Pokémon combinations, you can earn more points than just using brute strength. To use them, all generations must be enabled. For more information, check the Synergies List section.

tutorial.title: How does the Pokemon Calculator work?
tutorial.text:
You must choose one or two types to display their weaknesses, immunities, or strengths against other attacks.
There is an option to choose at random, or search for the Pokemon in question in the Pokedex if you don't know its types!

Gimmick Forms: These are the special forms of Pokemon (e.g., Mega Evolutions). You can choose to see them or not in the Pokedex.
